title: A recording with captions sits quiet while nothing is happening
goal: With a captioned recording open and nothing playing, the app keeps the main thread more than half busy, because the five caption style tiles in the panel animate their sample words thirty times a second and every tick lays the whole window out again. The Mac runs warm for nothing and every click lands on top of that work.
notes: Found 2026-09-27 by picking-or-retyping-a-caption-answers-at-once. Repro: a walk with openSampleTalk, captionsWaitForThemselves, wait 1.5 → 'never went quiet (46 of 46 slices busy, busiest 29.2ms); mainBusy 811.8ms over 857 passes, longest 14.1ms'. Same after captionsPickFirst: 0.6s waits read mainBusy 380-440ms over ~430 passes. sample(1) of the probe idle for 8s with a caption picked: 4526 main-thread samples, 1893 in NSWindow layoutIfNeeded, 598 in TimelineView UpdateFilter of which 566 in CaptionStylePreview.frame(atMS:) (532 TextRasterizer.rasterize). Each of the five tiles (CaptionStyleInspector.swift) runs its own TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1/30)) and re-rasterizes the preview text every tick; memoizing the last frame by TextContent does not help because previewText carries per-tick animation state (tried, never hit). Ideas: one shared clock for all tiles, a lower rate between word changes, pre-rendered frames per style, or rasterizing off the main thread.
acceptance: With the Sample Talk open, captions written and nothing playing, a walk's wait reads the main thread quiet (not 'never went quiet') for most of a 1.5s wait
The style tiles still show their words moving the way they do now, or a still frame when Reduce Motion is on
Picking a caption does not get slower (caption-pick-answers-at-once-walk stays green)

log.note: Reproduced 2026-09-28: caption-pick-answers-at-once-walk step 4 (1.5s idle after captions write) 'never went quiet (45 of 45 slices busy)', mainBusy 881ms over 844 passes. Freezing ONLY the five caption style tiles left it at 722ms/909 passes, still never quiet: sample(1) showed the six Transitions group tiles (AnimatedTransitionThumbnail, same 30fps TimelineView) doing the same thing, with NSWindow layoutIfNeeded + CA commit the bulk. Freezing both: quiet after 0.10s, mainBusy 174ms. Plan: pre-render each tile's lap once as distinct frames and let Core Animation play them (discrete CAKeyframeAnimation on layer contents, repeat forever), so the main thread does nothing between frames. The harness already treats forever animations as steady state (marching ants).

Built: LoopReel + CaptionLook.previewReel + TransitionTileLoop (PhotonzCore, LoopReelTests); VideoKit.LoopingFrames plays a reel as a repeating discrete CAKeyframeAnimation on layer contents; CaptionStylePreview rasterizes its lap off main, AnimatedTransitionThumbnail renders its ~35 distinct moments one per pass. Reels cached by style/size/scale. Gotcha found on the way: @State read only inside the GeometryReader closure never brought it back, so the three shadowless caption tiles stayed still; read in body now. New walk wait option busyUnderMS (onTheClock only) + guard walk a-captioned-recording-sits-quiet-walk (no flags): 147ms busy in the first 2s idle (one-time frame drawing), 3ms over 2s with a caption picked; the old tiles fail it at 983ms. caption-pick-answers-at-once-walk green, picks 46-60ms. All 24 caption walks and 8 of 9 transition walks green on the final build (tutorial-put-a-transition-on-a-cut-walk deferred, person at the Mac; it passed on the build before the kit refactor). Full suite green (10275 tests), kit typechecks alone.

left rough: Reduce Motion has no walk switch, so the still-frame branch (unchanged code in both tiles) was not exercised by a walk. No audit: this is a perf fix with no visible change; the pictures in the guard walk show all five caption tiles and the transition tiles playing.

Caption style and transition tiles now play on Core Animation from frames drawn once, so an idle captioned recording reads 3ms main-thread busy over 2s (was ~1200ms). Guard walk a-captioned-recording-sits-quiet-walk (new wait busyUnderMS) fails on the old tiles; caption and transition walks green; full suite green. Commit f8fe5834.
